page.overview:
Who is Betty Grof A.I.?

The Betty Grof A.I., also known as the Magical Betty Head, is the main antagonist of the episode "Broke His Crown". She is a magical A.I. that was created by Betty Grof out of her memories. She was created to reprogram Ice King's crowns wish magic in order to turn him back to normal.

The Betty A.I. was created by the real Betty after she stole Ice King's crown in the episode "King's Ransom".

In the episode "Broke His Crown", Marceline and Princess Bubblegum discover that there's something wrong with Ice King, more specifically His Crown. In order to discover the root of this, Princess Bubblegum uses her technology to transport both their consciousness into His Crown. Here, they discover that the root of the problems is being caused non other than the Betty Grof A.I., who was trying to reset the crown's wish magic by corrupting it in order to try and turn Ice King back into Simon. Together Marceline, Simon and Princess Bubblegum tried and failed to catch her. Simon eventually was able to get through to her by telling her that he loved her, causing her to discard her previous objective. Betty then informed them that the crown's defense systems were going back online, and she believed that she would be erased.

It was revealed at the end of the episode that she survived, but her facial structure had been rearranged/glitched.
